exercises.title: Protection by recapture
exercises.instruction: Watch Black take the advanced man, then recapture as White.

feedback.opening: Black takes the advanced man. Watch where the attacker lands.
feedback.initial: Now jump the attacker with White's supporting man.
feedback.success: White recaptured the attacker. Each side lost one man: the supporter made this an equal exchange.
feedback.invalidPiece: Use the white man that can recapture.

exercises.title: Nearby is not enough
exercises.instruction: Move White's king into a real recapture position to support the advanced man.

followUps.instruction: Recapture Black's attacker with the king you moved into support.

feedback.initial: The king has a real recapture now. Play it to complete the protection.
feedback.selected: Jump the attacker with White's king.
feedback.success: White's king recaptured the attacker. Each side lost one man: concrete support prevented a clean loss.

feedback.initial: The king is nearby, but cannot yet recapture an attacker landing beyond the advanced man.
feedback.selected: Work backward from Black's landing to find the king's supporting square.
feedback.awaitingReply: Watch Black's compulsory capture, then use the support you created.
feedback.success: White's king recaptured the attacker. Each side lost one man: concrete support prevented a clean loss.
feedback.goalMiss: Move the king onto the rear diagonal of Black's landing. That move does not give the king a recapture.

exercises.title: Protection by blocking
exercises.instruction: Move Black's edge piece while keeping the central capture landing blocked.

feedback.initial: White cannot jump the advanced black man while the landing behind it is occupied.
feedback.selected: Advance the edge piece without moving either central defender.
feedback.success: The edge piece advanced and the landing stayed blocked. White still has no capture.
feedback.goalMiss: Keep the central pair in place and move the edge piece. Vacating the blocker can expose its teammate.

exercises.title: Block the landing
exercises.instruction: Move White's rear man onto Black's required landing square.

feedback.initial: Deny the square Black would need beyond White's advanced man.
feedback.selected: Use the rear man to block the capture landing.
feedback.success: White physically occupied the landing. Black's jump is no longer available.
feedback.goalMiss: Move the rear man onto the square beyond its teammate. That move does not block Black's landing.

exercises.title: Place the supporter
exercises.instruction: Move White's central rear man into position to recapture Black's attacker.

followUps.instruction: Use the supporter you placed to recapture Black's attacker.

feedback.initial: Now finish the exchange with the supporting man.
feedback.success: The supporter recaptured Black's attacker. Both setup choices lead to one man lost by each side.
feedback.invalidPiece: Use the white man that can recapture.

followUps.instruction: Use the supporter you placed to recapture Black's attacker.

feedback.initial: Now finish the exchange with the supporting man.
feedback.success: The supporter recaptured Black's attacker. Both setup choices lead to one man lost by each side.
feedback.invalidPiece: Use the white man that can recapture.

feedback.initial: Keep the outer rear pieces in place. Either diagonal step by the central rear man can supply support.
feedback.selected: Position the central rear man next to Black's eventual landing.
feedback.awaitingReply: Black takes the advanced man. Next, play the recapture you arranged.
feedback.success: The supporter recaptured Black's attacker. Both setup choices lead to one man lost by each side.
feedback.goalMiss: Move the central rear man. The outer rear pieces must stay to block a second jump and preserve the recapture.
